findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "ozerki" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, get_product, present_choices · Private data: get_faq · Public sink: search_products, present_choices.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, get_product, present_choices · Private data: get_faq · Public sink: search_products, present_choices

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
